crossRefs.note: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
“ ‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,
You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You…
But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and…
and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace…
But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of…
Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, “There is…
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I…
All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
Yahweh’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not…
no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

translations.web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
translations.bsb: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.
translations.kjv: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
translations.asv: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; But he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.
